title: Становление богом 2
alt: Вечный божественный дух 2 / Стократная закалка духа 2 / Apotheosis 2 Apotheosis 2 百炼成神2

en:
The family fell and his loved ones suffered. Luo Zheng fell from the clouds and became a humble domestic slave. In a world where various races are constantly fighting and ruled by mysterious forces, Luo Zheng, who is unwilling to fall, accidentally acquires a mysterious skill and refines himself as a weapon. This is the beginning of a struggle. Pulled open with a bang.
